seoTitle: Moon Phase Calculator: Phase, Illumination, Next Full Moon
metaDescription: Find the moon phase for any date, percent lit, and the next new and full moons, plus a month table. Free, offline.
intro: Gives moon phase name, illumination, age and the next full and new moons for a date, and a day-by-day table for the month.
why:
Look up the phase for a birthday, a photo shoot or a garden plan. New and full moon times use the main terms of Meeus's method.

Checked against the ephem library: moon event times within 2 minutes on three cases, illumination within about 5 points. Dates are UTC and the local date may differ.
howTo: Tick Show every day of the month if you want the table.
Read the phase, illumination and next moons.

faq.a: Within a few minutes of the ephem library in my checks.
UTC, evaluated at noon UTC for the date.
